simple.summary: חֹבָב (Chôbâb) means Chobab , father-in-law of Moses First listed occurrence: Judg 4 11.

definitions.full: H2246. Chobab חֹבָב proper name, masculine (compare Phoenician proper name חב ; We Skizzen iii, 171. 217 suggests comparison with serpent ) — son of Reuel, חֹתֵן of Moses (see חתן ), Num 10:29 (J E), Judg 4:11 ; insert ׳ח probably also 1:16 , see GFM.
